dialogue.origin: はじめましてかいがらさん。相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Nice to meet you, Kaigara-san. I'm the counselor. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: お願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 今回はどのようなご相談内容ですか？
dialogue.content: How can I help you today?

dialogue.origin: 仕事が辛くて悩んでます
dialogue.content: I'm struggling because my job is really tough.

dialogue.origin: 仕事がきつくて悩んでいるのですね。
dialogue.content: So, you're struggling because your job is demanding.

dialogue.origin: それはお辛いですね。
dialogue.content: That must be really difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: 仕事がきついというか辛いんです
dialogue.content: It's not just demanding; it's painful.

dialogue.origin: お辛いんですね。
dialogue.content: It feels painful for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どのようなときに辛いと感じるのか具体的に教えてもらっていいですか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me more specifically about what makes you feel that it's painful?

dialogue.origin: 何から言えばいいのか、、、
dialogue.content: I'm not sure where to start...

dialogue.origin: なにから言えばいいのかわからないのですね。
dialogue.content: You're not sure where to begin.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: いつぐらいからお仕事がお辛いと感じはじめましたか？
dialogue.content: When did you start to feel that work was so painful?

dialogue.origin: 派遣社員なんですが今の会社についてすぐです
dialogue.content: I’m a temporary employee, and it started right after I joined the current company.

dialogue.origin: 半年前くらい
dialogue.content: About six months ago.

dialogue.origin: 部署の雰囲気も人間関係も悪くて、、、
dialogue.content: The atmosphere in the department and the relationships are bad...

dialogue.origin: 今の会社についてすぐにそう感じたのですね。
dialogue.content: So you felt that way right after you joined the company.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 人間関係も悪いと感じるのですね。
dialogue.content: You also feel the interpersonal dynamics are poor.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それはつらいですよね。
dialogue.content: That must be difficult.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今の派遣会社に入ってすぐにお辛いことがあったのですか？
dialogue.content: Did something difficult happen right after you started this placement?

dialogue.origin: まず、部署の人が全員仲が悪くて、必要以外の口を聞かないんです
dialogue.content: First of all, everyone in the department doesn't get along, and they don't speak unless it's absolutely necessary.

dialogue.origin: とにかく部長が変わり者で、会社の中でも気に入っている数人としか、ろくに話もしない人なんです
dialogue.content: The department manager is particularly strange; he barely speaks to anyone except for a few people he likes.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。部署の人たちが業務以外は会話しないと言うことですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So, people in the department don't converse outside of work matters.

dialogue.origin: それは居心地は悪いですね。
dialogue.content: That must be an uncomfortable environment.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 私とも最低限しか話してくれません
dialogue.content: He only says the bare minimum to me as well.

dialogue.origin: 部長さんが特に変わり者でお気に入りの人しか話さないのですね。
dialogue.content: So the manager is particularly odd and only talks to his favorites.

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 最低限でしか話さないと嫌わてるか不安になりますよね。
dialogue.content: When someone only says the bare minimum to you, it can make you worry that you're disliked.

dialogue.origin: 仕事もやりにくし。
dialogue.content: And it makes it hard to do your job.

dialogue.origin: はい、わからないことを聞いてもろくに答えてくれないので自分でなんとかするしかないです
dialogue.content: Yes, even when I ask about something I don't understand, he doesn't give me a proper answer, so I have to figure it out on my own.

dialogue.origin: 誰も助けてくれないし
dialogue.content: And no one helps me.

dialogue.origin: 答えを教えてくれないし自分で解決しないといけないんですね。
dialogue.content: They don’t give you answers, and you have to resolve things on your own.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 誰も助けてくれないと正解がわからないから不安になりますよね。
dialogue.content: When no one helps you, it must be worrying not knowing if you're doing things correctly.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 失敗して周りから変な目で見られないかとか
dialogue.content: You might worry about making a mistake and having people look at you strangely.

dialogue.origin: 職場にもいづらくなるし
dialogue.content: And it makes the workplace uncomfortable.

dialogue.origin: あまりそうは思わないですけど仕事がやりにくいです
dialogue.content: I don't really think about it that way, but it does make it difficult to do my job.

dialogue.origin: そうは感じないんですね。仕事がやりにくんですね。
dialogue.content: So you don’t feel that way; it’s more that the work is hard to do.

dialogue.origin: ちゃんと指示もしてくれないので自分で考えてやるしかないので
dialogue.content: They don’t give proper instructions, so I have to figure things out and do it on my own.

dialogue.origin: 自分でやらないといけないですね。それは悩みますよね。
dialogue.content: You have to do it all by yourself. That must be stressful.

dialogue.origin: 職場で相談できる方とかはいますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anyone at work you can talk to about this?

dialogue.origin: 庶務の人とかに少し話しますがそれでこれまでの派遣社員はみんなすぐ辞めていったそうで会社も困ってるらしいです
dialogue.content: I talk a bit with the general affairs staff, and they said that all the previous temp workers quit quickly. Apparently, the company is troubled by it.

dialogue.origin: 庶務の人と会話をしますが派遣方はみんな辞めていったんですね。
dialogue.content: So you've talked with the general affairs staff, and you've heard all the previous temporary employees have quit.

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: そうなると解決しないって思って不安にはなりますよね。
dialogue.content: Hearing that must make you feel anxious, thinking that the problem won't be solved.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, it does.

dialogue.origin: かいがらさんは仕事をつづけたいと考えですか？
dialogue.content: Are you hoping to continue this job, Kaigara-san?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。かいがらさんの中で一番お辛いのは職場の上司とのご関係が上手くいってないことですかね？
dialogue.content: I see. Would you say the most painful part for you is that your relationship with your manager isn’t going well?

dialogue.origin: 隣の人もひとりごととかチッチっていつも歯を鳴らして？いたりして全部辛いです
dialogue.content: The person next to me is always muttering to themselves or clicking their tongue... it's all just distressing.

dialogue.origin: 上司だけでなく他の人間関係もつらいということですね。
dialogue.content: So it’s not just your boss; other relationships at work are also difficult.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 『やめてほしい』と直接伝えたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you ever directly told them you'd like them to stop?

dialogue.origin: 隣の人にですか？
dialogue.content: To the person next to me?

dialogue.origin: 隣の人や上司の方などにです。
dialogue.content: To the person next to you, or your boss.

dialogue.origin: お2人ともかなり年上の方だし、私は派遣社員なので言えません
dialogue.content: They are both quite a bit older than me, and since I'm a temporary employee, I can't say anything.

dialogue.origin: 確かに言えないですよね。気まずくなるのも嫌だし。
dialogue.content: That’s understandable—it can be hard to say, and you don’t want things to become awkward.

dialogue.origin: 言ったところで変わるものでしょうか、、、
dialogue.content: Even if I said something, would anything change...?

dialogue.origin: やっぱり我慢するしかないんですかね
dialogue.content: I guess I just have to put up with it, don't I?

dialogue.origin: 言ってもいいのか言わないほうがいいのかわからないですよね。
dialogue.content: It’s hard to know whether it’s better to speak up or not.

dialogue.origin: 我慢するのも辛いし
dialogue.content: And enduring it is painful, too.

dialogue.origin: 庶務係の方にもこのような内容は相談されましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you discussed these specific issues with the people in general affairs?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 知っているそうです前はもっとひどかったとか聞きました
dialogue.content: They said they know about it, and I heard it used to be even worse.

dialogue.origin: 他の方も相談されていたんですね。
dialogue.content: So others have also brought it up.

dialogue.origin: 派遣社員がどんどんやめていますから
dialogue.content: Because the temp workers keep quitting.

dialogue.origin: 確かに。それだと言っても難しいかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: I see. In that case, it might be difficult even if you say something.

dialogue.origin: 言ってるけど、どうにもならないからここで相談してみようと、、、
dialogue.content: I have mentioned it, but nothing changes, so I thought I would try consulting here...

dialogue.origin: 派遣なんて我慢するかやめるかしかないでしょうか
dialogue.content: As a temp worker, are my only options to either endure it or quit?

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね。いろいろと悩まれて相談にこられたんですね。
dialogue.content: I understand—you’ve been wrestling with a lot and came here to talk it through.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 派遣だからとかそうなことはないですよ。職場の雰囲気を改善を主張する権利はあります。
dialogue.content: Being a temp doesn’t mean you have no say. You have the right to advocate for an improved workplace environment.

dialogue.origin: どうすればいいですか？
dialogue.content: What should I do?

dialogue.origin: かいがらさんの中で相談できる上司の方はいますか？
dialogue.content: Is there any supervisor you feel you could consult with?

dialogue.origin: 上司はその部長1人なのでいません
dialogue.content: The only supervisor is that department head, so no.

dialogue.origin: この状況は会社の人たちみんな知っていることで会社も困ってるらしいですかる
dialogue.content: Everyone at the company knows about this situation, and apparently, the company is troubled by it too.

dialogue.origin: から
dialogue.content: so...

dialogue.origin: 派遣会社の担当も知っていて半年続く人はいなかったので、と感謝されています
dialogue.content: The representative at the staffing agency also knows, and they’ve thanked me, saying no one has lasted six months before.

dialogue.origin: けれど、本当に辛くて、、、
dialogue.content: But it's really painful...

dialogue.origin: 感謝はされるけど改善されないとお辛いですよね。
dialogue.content: Being appreciated is nice, but if nothing improves, it's still painful for you.

dialogue.origin: だから誰に相談しても無駄なんだと思ってますがやっぱり我慢するしかなさそうですよね
dialogue.content: That's why I think it's useless to talk to anyone. It really seems like I have no choice but to endure it.

dialogue.origin: 我慢する必要はないと思います。かいがらさんがつらくなるだけなので
dialogue.content: I don’t think you need to just endure it; that would only make things harder on you.

dialogue.origin: 派遣が会社の担当に根気よく伝えるか
dialogue.content: You could either persistently communicate this to your staffing agency representative,

dialogue.origin: それでダメなら派遣先を変更してもらうとか
dialogue.content: and if that doesn’t work, ask to be reassigned to a different placement.

dialogue.origin: わかりました。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: お時間になりましたのでご相談ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Our time is up for today. Thank you for coming in.

topic.sub: 人間関係の悪化による業務への影響
